english: and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges.
text: 收益成了后续建设的资金，were used to build 交代的是钱用来做什么。它与 used to do 表示“过去常常”不同；表达用途时保留 be used to do，也可说 be used for building。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
